[name]
[email] · [phone] · [url]
Chicago, IL

EXPERIENCE

Deloitte Consulting LLP — Strategy & Operations, Chicago, IL
Consultant · Jan 2025 – Present (promoted after 17 months; standard cycle is 24)
• Led the procurement workstream of a cost-transformation program for a $2B industrial manufacturer: analyzed $640M of addressable spend across 1,900 suppliers, ran 6 category sourcing events and identified $4.0M of annualized savings, $2.6M of which were contracted before the engagement ended.
• Built the integration operating model for a merger of two hospital systems (11 hospitals, $3.1B combined revenue): designed the shared-services structure for finance, HR and supply chain, and produced the 18-month integration roadmap approved by the combined board.
• Managed two business analysts day to day and reviewed all client-facing deliverables for the workstream.
• Selected as one of 12 consultants (of about 140 in the office) for the 2026 firm-sponsored data analytics certification cohort.
• Built the client's category-management playbook (12 categories, supplier scorecards, quarterly business review templates) and trained 9 client procurement staff to run it; the client's procurement lead presented the results to the executive committee.
• Led a 6-week diagnostic for a $600M building-products distributor that sized a $9M EBITDA improvement opportunity across pricing, freight and warehouse labor; converted into a 9-month implementation engagement.

Business Analyst · Aug 2023 – Dec 2024
• Built a 5-year financial model and 40-slide investment case for a regional grocery chain's $85M distribution-center expansion; the client's board approved the project in Q2 2024.
• Interviewed 35 plant managers and finance leads across three sites to map the order-to-cash process for a packaging company; identified 14 handoffs that were consolidated to 6, cutting invoice cycle time from 11 days to 4.
• Ran the weekly status reporting for a 9-person engagement team; received the practice's "above expectations" rating in both annual reviews.
• Developed the practice's internal benchmark database of hospital shared-services costs (31 health systems), reused on four subsequent engagements.

Summer Business Analyst · Jun 2022 – Aug 2022
• Supported a pricing study for a specialty chemicals client; built the price-waterfall analysis for 1,200 SKUs that found $1.9M of unrealized discounts.

EDUCATION
University of Michigan, Ann Arbor — B.A. Economics, cum laude, May 2023 · GPA 3.72/4.00
Minor in Statistics · James B. Angell Scholar (two consecutive terms of all-A grades)
Honors thesis on the labor market effects of state minimum wage increases; University Honors Program

LEADERSHIP AND ACTIVITIES
• Michigan Men's Rowing (club) — Captain, 2022–23; rowed in the varsity eight; organized a 44-athlete team's travel and a $60k annual budget; team placed 4th at the American Collegiate Rowing Association national championship in 2023.
• Eagle Scout, Boy Scouts of America, 2018 — led a 30-volunteer project building trail boardwalks for a county forest preserve.
• Deloitte Chicago Pro Bono Program — project lead for a food-bank logistics assessment, 2025 (120 hours).
• Michigan Economics Society — Vice President, 2022–23; organized a 12-speaker alumni careers series.

SKILLS
Excel (financial modeling), PowerPoint, Alteryx, Tableau, SQL (intermediate), Python (basic) · Spanish (professional working proficiency)

OTHER
Chicago Marathon finisher (2024, 2025) · Volunteer tutor, Chicago Scholars, 2024 – Present
